description: Erection of a bungalow with one bedroom following demolition of three garages.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Energy and Sustainability Statement and SAP Worksheets, Transport Statement, Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report, Design and Access Statement, Drainage Strategy, Fire Safety Statement Received: 06/07/2022; Location Plan, o Existing (Site) Plan, Existing Front Elevation (West), Existing Flank Elevation (North), Existing Elevation (East), Existing Flank Elevation (South), Existing Section AA, Existing Section BB, Proposed Site Plan, Proposed Floor Plan,  Proposed Roof Plan, Proposed Front Elevation (West),  Proposed Flank Elevation (North), Proposed Rear Elevation (East), Proposed Flank Elevation (South) & Proposed Section BB Received 04/01/2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, details of secure cycle storage arrangements in accordance with both the London Plan and adopted Local Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle parking shall conform to the West London Cycle Parking Guidance and hard surface paths not less than 1.2 metres wide must be provided to the doors of the cycle stores. The cycle stores shall be made available to occupants upon first occupation of the hereby approved development and maintained as such thereafter without obstruction.
Condition : 7 - The hereby approved development must be carried out in accordance with the approved Energy Statement received 06/07/2022, and achieve net 'Zero Carbon' emissions.

Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 Litres per person per day or less.

Condition : 9 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
o	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
o	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
o	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans and in the supporting documents, prior to commencement of groundworks (excluding site investigations and demolition), the applicant shall have submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing and obtained the Authority's approval for approval a final updated detailed drainage design, including drawings and supporting calculations with updated attenuation volume calculations to include the whole site area and a schedule of maintenance tasks for the water butts and rain gardens/planters. The runoff rate shall not exceed 2.5 litres/second.  The management schedule therein shall confirm routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components to be maintained for the lifetime of the development. The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.

Condition : 11 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme hereby approved has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 12 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/ buildings/enclosures within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out, other than as shown in the approved drawings, and no additional floor space shall be formed within the building(s) hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division (new mezzanine level) without prior written approval of the local planning authority.

Condition : 13 - The trees identified within the hereby approved Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report shall be protected before commencement of any works on site and throughout the course of the development by methods outlined in the Report submitted 06/07/2022 and that conform to the best practice guidance contained in British Standard BS5837: 2012 or any guidance that shall have superseded it.

Condition : 14 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, full details of the roof solar panels shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and thereafter implemented as approved and brought into operation before first occupation.

Condition : 15 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular access shall be permanently closed and the kerbs and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.

Condition : 16 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, full details of the Air Source Heat Pump shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and thereafter implemented as approved and brought into operation before first occupation.

Condition : 17 - Before the development hereby permitted commences, the applicant shall have reached a legally binding agreement with the land owner (the London Borough of Hounslow) to secure a landscaping agreement making provisions for the relocation of the resident's drying area and for general landscape improvements. The development shall be carried out in accordance with this agreement.

Condition : 18 - Before the development hereby permitted commences (excluding site investigation), the applicant shall enter into an agreement with the land owner (the London Borough of Hounslow) to ensure that satisfactory refuse storage and collection arrangements are maintained for the residents of 1-6 Beaconsfield Close for the duration of the construction programme.
